results.title: Canonical milestones
results.sql: SELECT count(*) AS milestones FROM milestones;

results.title: Milestones per age group
results.sql: SELECT ag.code, ag.label_he, count(m.id) AS milestones FROM age_groups ag LEFT JOIN milestones m ON m.age_group_id = ag.id GROUP BY ag.code, ag.label_he, ag.display_order ORDER BY ag.display_order;

results.title: Sub-milestones (Excel video segments) and handbook exercises
results.sql: SELECT activity_type, count(*) FROM activities GROUP BY activity_type ORDER BY 1;

results.title: Hebrew content records (current source versions)
results.sql:
SELECT 'milestone_translations (pdf)' AS kind, count(*) FROM milestone_translations WHERE language='he' AND source_origin='pdf' AND source_version_id IN (SELECT current_version_id FROM source_documents WHERE current_version_id IS NOT NULL)
UNION ALL SELECT 'activity_translations (pdf)', count(*) FROM activity_translations WHERE language='he' AND source_origin='pdf' AND source_version_id IN (SELECT current_version_id FROM source_documents WHERE current_version_id IS NOT NULL)
UNION ALL SELECT 'activity_translations (excel)', count(*) FROM activity_translations WHERE language='he' AND source_origin='excel' AND source_version_id IN (SELECT current_version_id FROM source_documents WHERE current_version_id IS NOT NULL)
UNION ALL SELECT 'knowledge_chunks', count(*) FROM knowledge_chunks WHERE language='he' AND source_version_id IN (SELECT current_version_id FROM source_documents WHERE current_version_id IS NOT NULL)
UNION ALL SELECT 'source_references', count(*) FROM source_references WHERE language='he' AND source_version_id IN (SELECT current_version_id FROM source_documents WHERE current_version_id IS NOT NULL);

results.title: Arabic content records (current source versions)
results.sql:
SELECT 'milestone_translations (pdf)' AS kind, count(*) FROM milestone_translations WHERE language='ar' AND source_origin='pdf' AND source_version_id IN (SELECT current_version_id FROM source_documents WHERE current_version_id IS NOT NULL)
UNION ALL SELECT 'activity_translations (pdf)', count(*) FROM activity_translations WHERE language='ar' AND source_origin='pdf' AND source_version_id IN (SELECT current_version_id FROM source_documents WHERE current_version_id IS NOT NULL)
UNION ALL SELECT 'activity_translations (excel)', count(*) FROM activity_translations WHERE language='ar' AND source_origin='excel' AND source_version_id IN (SELECT current_version_id FROM source_documents WHERE current_version_id IS NOT NULL)

UNION ALL SELECT 'source_references', count(*) FROM source_references WHERE language='ar' AND source_version_id IN (SELECT current_version_id FROM source_documents WHERE current_version_id IS NOT NULL);

results.title: Instructional videos by language
results.sql: SELECT language, count(*) AS videos FROM videos GROUP BY language ORDER BY 1;

results.title: Video availability (YouTube oEmbed check)
results.sql: SELECT availability_status, count(*), max(last_checked_at) AS last_checked FROM videos GROUP BY 1;

results.title: Active video mappings by language and confidence
results.sql: SELECT language, confidence_status, count(*) FROM activity_video_mappings WHERE is_active GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2;

results.title: Mapping traceability (must be 0)
results.sql: SELECT count(*) AS mappings_without_source_row FROM activity_video_mappings WHERE source_sheet IS NULL OR source_row_number IS NULL OR raw_sub_milestone_code IS NULL;

results.title: Mappings by relationship type
results.sql: SELECT mapping_type, count(*) FROM activity_video_mappings GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

results.title: Milestone 1.1 — sub-milestone → video (with Excel source row)
Milestones without any video mapping
results.sql: SELECT m.milestone_code FROM milestones m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activity_video_mappings x WHERE x.milestone_id = m.id AND x.is_active) ORDER BY m.display_order;

results.title: Sub-milestones listed in the workbook without a video
results.sql: SELECT count(*) AS missing_video_mappings FROM import_issues WHERE code = 'missing_video_mapping' AND NOT is_resolved AND import_job_id = (SELECT id FROM import_jobs WHERE job_type='video_workbook' AND status='published' ORDER BY finished_at DESC LIMIT 1);

results.title: Derived segment ↔ exercise links
results.sql: SELECT link_type, method, count(*) FROM activity_links GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1;

results.title: Development domains (from the scale chart)
results.sql: SELECT coalesce(development_domain, '(none)') AS domain, count(*) FROM milestones GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

results.title: PDF page references for milestone 1.1
results.sql: SELECT r.language, sd.document_key, r.pdf_page_index, r.printed_page_number, r.section_heading FROM source_references r JOIN source_versions sv ON sv.id = r.source_version_id JOIN source_documents sd ON sd.id = sv.source_document_id JOIN milestones m ON m.id = r.milestone_id WHERE m.milestone_code='1.1' AND r.activity_id IS NULL ORDER BY 1;

rows.section_heading: עוקב במבט אחרי עצם נע / פנים

results.title: Milestone translations flagged for editorial review
results.sql: SELECT m.milestone_code, t.language, t.content_review_status FROM milestone_translations t JOIN milestones m ON m.id = t.milestone_id WHERE t.source_origin='pdf' AND t.is_primary AND t.content_review_status <> 'unreviewed' ORDER BY 1,2;

results.title: Unresolved import issues by severity
results.sql: SELECT severity, count(*) FROM import_issues WHERE NOT is_resolved GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'error' THEN 1 WHEN 'warning' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;

results.title: Unresolved import issues by code
results.sql: SELECT severity, code, count(*) FROM import_issues WHERE NOT is_resolved GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,3 DESC;

results.title: Source documents and versions
results.sql: SELECT sd.document_key, sd.source_type, sd.language, sv.version_number, sv.page_count, sv.import_status, left(sv.checksum, 16) AS checksum FROM source_documents sd JOIN source_versions sv ON sv.source_document_id = sd.id ORDER BY 1, 4;

results.title: Import jobs
results.sql: SELECT job_type, status, count(*) FROM import_jobs GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2;
